modalities.evidence: acquiring rs-fMRI with a GE 3T MRI scanner
Data also includes T1w and DWI sequences.

output.population: Human; Fibromyalgia; ages 21–70; fibromyalgia patients and matched healthy controls
output.summary: Resting-state functional MRI acquired before and after music or pink noise exposure in fibromyalgia patients and matched healthy controls, with T1-weighted and diffusion-weighted sequences also included.
